# Vellum

Vellum is a dual-mode editorial theme pairing Playfair Display headings with Charm body text, offering warm Vanilla Parchment for composing and Calm Charcoal for night reading. Style Settings controls a sepia toggle, hiding the interface until it is needed, and the fonts, spacing, width and accent colours. The recorded description states that the layouts are mobile-responsive and tested against WCAG AA.

![Vellum screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rohith-am/Obsidian-Vellum/HEAD/Vellum_Screenshot.jpg)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Vellum"
    author: "Rohith A"
    repo:   "rohith-am/Obsidian-Vellum"
    slug:   "vellum"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/vellum"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/rohith-am/Obsidian-Vellum"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rohith-am/Obsidian-Vellum/HEAD/Vellum_Screenshot.jpg"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Compose on warm Vanilla Parchment by day or read in Calm Charcoal by night with a dual-mode, editorial theme pairing Playfair Display headings and Charm body text. Toggle sepia, hide the UI until needed, tweak fonts, spacing, width and accent colors via Style Settings, and use WCAG AA–tested, mobile-responsive layouts."
}
```
